details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15236-15250 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: validation_harness_pin only matches `validate.yml@<40 hex>`, but `.github/workflows/internal-validate.yml:49` uses `validate.yml@promote-candidate`, so the pin never resolves in coding-workflows itself.
  WHY: Harness holds there stay at pin_unresolved/support unknown and never auto-resume until `/revalidate` or the 14-day expiry. Severity was MAJOR for most reviewers.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15695-15743 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: In validation_harness_hold_tick, the `ENABLE_VALIDATION != true` early return (15695-15697) runs before the VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS expiry check (15732-15743).
  WHY: With validation disabled, an active hold never expires and the project is never parked. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT, the others MAJOR.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2487-2500; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15999-16000 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: validation_owner_fixed sets raw_status=codex_failure for engine_unavailable (line 2489), but the poller enters the harness hold only when raw_status=harness_error.
  WHY: The failure is reported as harness-owned, yet the project never enters the pin-based hold, so a shipped fix does not resume it. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT and called it a likely deliberate scoping choice; the others MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15015-15142,15657-15674 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: _validation_harness_hold_resume treats a zero return from dispatch_validation_if_needed as a dispatch, but that function also returns 0 on its deferral paths.
  WHY: The resume counters (per-fingerprint 2, total 4) are spent and a "resumed" comment and marker are posted when no run started.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_validation_harness_hold_resume (dispatch-failure branch) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A persistently failing dispatch restores the hold and the resume is retried every tick, with no bound.
  WHY: Each 5-minute tick adds extra API calls and state comments until someone intervenes.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:660-668; scripts/unblock_judge.sh:526-560 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: _harness_ops says a heal report "is being sent" whenever an accepted label exists, but the executor can still skip it (PR item, WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false, and so on).
  WHY: The durable comment misstates that a report was sent.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:626-651 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _heal_report_op reads labels from the wave issue (ctx["labels"]), but `ai:harness-broken` is added only to the tracking issue (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15353, 16091). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash found that unblock_scan.py:330 builds project item labels as only [TRACKING_LABEL].
  WHY: No accepted label is found, so sendable=false and the heal report is skipped. Severity: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said BLOCKER; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 raised the same gap as a task gap.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1501-1524 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: validation_path_owner treats a path as harness-owned only if it is absent from the consumer checkout. Staged harness files in `${PWD}` therefore classify as "project".
  WHY: Consumers get fix-up issues for harness files they cannot fix.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1429-1813 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: build_engine_fallback_payload does not validate the metadata structure before accessing keys such as run_refs or run_attempt.
  WHY: A malformed payload could raise KeyError and crash the heal report workflow.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1035-1239 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: File manipulation and jq queries run without checking that required directories or files exist.
  WHY: Missing temp files cause cryptic failures that can crash the intake job.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1638-1653 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: This block uses plain `gh api` calls without handling 429 or 5xx errors, unlike other parts of the script that use gh_retry.
  WHY: Transient failures fail the heal intake unnecessarily.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:1885-1929 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The heal-report job lacks a "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" step.
  WHY: gh_api_retry is unavailable, so transient API errors while fetching the promote-candidate branch fail the job. Reviewer anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped this claim as invalid, citing a local fallback shim.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15395-15410 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _validation_harness_hold_compare calls `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq` for the pin commit date, but _safe_gh_jq may not be defined in the poller environment.
  WHY: If it is undefined, the date stays empty and the hold waits indefinitely with pin_date_unknown.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Phase 3 of docs/plans/validation-failure-harness-routing-plan.md: a harness-owned verdict must "send one workflow failure heal report"; the intake accepts it when it carries a label in HEAL_REPORT_LABELS.
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py:626-651 (_heal_report_op), scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15353/16091, or HEAL_REPORT_LABELS (unblock_actions.py:165-172)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: ai:harness-broken is added only to TRACKING_NUM (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15353, 16091), _heal_report_op reads ctx["labels"] from the wave issue (unblock_actions.py:629-630), and HEAL_REPORT_LABELS (unblock_actions.py:165-172) lacks ai:validation-failed. A wave issue stopped at plain ai:blocked therefore gets sendable=false. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT/2 as a design coverage limit; the others rated it BLOCKER/MAJOR.
- requirement: Phase 2: "When a project's item is held, it stays failed ... Validation resumes once a harness fix ships in the pinned workflow; `/revalidate` resumes it now."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, validation_harness_hold_tick() and validation_harness_pin()
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: validation_harness_pin (15241-15248) requires a 40-hex SHA, but internal-validate.yml:49 uses a branch ref, so Steps 3 and 5 never run in coding-workflows. validation_harness_hold_tick has no resume logic covering every scenario the plan describes (reviewer google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, MAJOR, confidence 3).
- requirement: Phase 2: "When a project's runtime validation fails because of the validation harness ... waits for a harness fix instead of paging a person."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, validation_harness_hold_active() (line 15303) and mark_validation_failed() (around 16020-16084)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: validation_harness_hold_active requires raw_status == "harness_error", while validate_process.sh:2489 sets raw_status="codex_failure" for engine_unavailable. These harness failures are reported upstream but never enter the pin-based hold.
- requirement: Phase 2: "A hold older than VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS (default 14, 1-365), or with a missing or invalid start time, ends and parks the project for a person."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, validation_harness_hold_tick() (15695-15698)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The ENABLE_VALIDATION != "true" early return at line 15695 precedes the expiry check at lines 15739-15743, so the hold never expires while validation is disabled.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:validation_harness_pin (about 15200-15250) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pin regex only matches `validate.yml@<40 hex>`, but `.github/workflows/internal-validate.yml:49` uses `validate.yml@promote-candidate`, so no pin resolves here.
  WHY: Every harness hold reaches pin_unresolved or support_baselined and logs "waiting" each tick. It never resumes on a harness fix, until `/revalidate` or the 14-day expiry.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15695-15698 vs 15732-15743 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The validation_disabled early return runs before the VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD_MAX_DAYS expiry check.
  WHY: If validation is switched off, the hold never expires and the project is never parked, contradicting the README's 14-day claim.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_validation_harness_hold_resume (`if ! dispatch_validation_if_needed 1`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Success is judged only by the return status, but dispatch_validation_if_needed also returns 0 on deferral paths.
  WHY: The resume is counted and the "resumed" comment and marker are posted even though no run started.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_validation_harness_hold_resume (dispatch-failure branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A persistent dispatch failure restores the hold and the resume retries on every tick.
  WHY: Each tick costs extra API calls and two state comments, and nothing bounds it.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2489 with scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15999 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: engine_unavailable is reported as harness-owned, but its raw_status is codex_failure, so the poller never starts the pin-based hold.
  WHY: A shipped harness fix does not resume the project. The reviewer called this probably a deliberate scoping choice.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_harness_ops comment body | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment promises a report whenever an accepted label is set, but unblock_send_heal_report can still skip it.
  WHY: The durable comment is misleading, although a WARNING is paged.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 3, "a harness-owned verdict must send one workflow failure heal report"
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_actions.py `_heal_report_op`
  Evidence of absence: Labels such as `ai:harness-broken` go to the tracking issue only (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15353 and 16091). A wave issue at plain `ai:blocked` has no accepted label, so the report is skipped with a WARNING and a page. The reviewer called this a coverage limit of the design.
  severity=NIT | confidence=2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
